parent_objective: refresh current-family protected rows before more PPO because the old single key is saturated

public_gates: mine current-family protected surface candidates around M263 and M264
check source diversity across seeds physical pairs and margin buckets
require wrong-history outcome sensitivity rather than only action distance
do not admit PPO from a duplicate-dominated surface
record whether old protected key is representative or saturated
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M266
do not loosen the old protected key without evidence
do not tune from private holdout evidence
do not promote a checkpoint in M266
hypothesis: A current-family protected-surface refresh can determine whether M264's protected-key saturation is a single-key artifact or a broader proof-surface constraint.
success_criteria: M266 mines or audits current-family protected candidates without PPO
M266 reports accepted wrong-history rows and diversity metrics
M266 records whether the old protected key is representative, stale, or saturated
M266 records a concrete next milestone decision before more PPO
failure_criteria: candidate surface is duplicate-dominated or has zero accepted wrong-history outcome rows
audit cannot distinguish single-key saturation from broader proof loss
M266 starts PPO or changes actor inputs

commands.name: m266_protected_surface_refresh
commands.command: Run a current-family protected-surface refresh around M263/M264 and summarize diversity plus old-key representativeness.

decision_rule: M266 may not promote a checkpoint. It must decide whether to convert a refreshed surface into replay/objective gates, redesign protected-key handling, or admit one more repaired PPO repeat.
